caption: The drawing depicts a single upholstered chair with a rounded seat and a straight backrest, which features two horizontal rectangular cutouts. The chair is covered with a vertical striped pattern formed by yellow and green shades, with fine black lines accentuating the texture. The seat has a circular outline, and the bottom edge of the chair is adorned with a decorative fringe or skirt that follows the same striped color pattern. The backrest is outlined in black and features additional yellow and green shading. The drawing is enclosed within a simple rectangular border on a beige background, and there is a signature at the bottom right corner reading "E. Schwabe."
title: Epaulet
